crossCutting: 外交・通商・移民が分かれた話題ではなく、同じ政策パッケージとして扱われ始めている。
金利とエネルギーの見通しは、地政学イベントのたびに再計算されている。
AIは計算資源の更新とガバナンス議論が切り離せない段階に入っている。
watchItems: EUと英国の関係修復が実務レベルでどこまで進むか。

politics: G7、EU、英国、移民、対米通商の5本で構成。いずれも直近の政策判断に直結するものを優先した。

economy: Fed、フランス成長見通し、関税、エネルギーの4系統を束ね、地政学が実体経済に与える波及を重視した。
市場短期反応だけの材料は外し、政策変更や見通し修正を伴うものを残した。
technology: TPU更新、Linux脆弱性、Anthropic関連のAI統治議論を優先し、実装・安全保障・規制の3面をそろえた。
研究系の話題は、計算資源と運用ルールに接続できるものだけを採用した。
decisions: より古いAIモデル発表や単発の市場コメントは、直近の政策・製品判断に結びつかないため見送った。

en.title: 2026-06-22 G7 Fallout, Tariffs, Migration, and Brexit Keep Politics Busy
en.description: G7 fallout, EU-US trade rules, migration votes, Brexit chatter, and a more cautious Fed are all moving at once, keeping policy and markets on edge.
en.rssSummary: G7, tariffs, migration, Fed, and AI governance move together.
en.opening: Politics is being driven by the aftershocks of the G7, plus EU migration and UK reset debates. On the economic side, the Fed, tariffs, and energy prices are shaping expectations, while technology is split between new TPU hardware, a Linux security issue, and a fresh round of AI governance scrutiny.
crossCutting: Diplomacy, trade, and migration are being treated as one policy stack rather than separate stories.
Rate expectations are being reset every time geopolitics shifts energy and inflation assumptions.
AI now moves on two tracks at once: faster infrastructure and tighter governance.
watchItems: How far EU-UK cooperation can move from signaling into implementation.
Whether the Fed gets more explicit about the timing of any cuts.
Whether TPU and model supply constraints change deployment plans at major buyers.

politics: The five picks cover the G7 aftermath, EU-UK relations, tariffs, migration, and public opinion on Brexit reversal because they affect live policy choices.
Polling was kept because it helps explain why UK-EU rhetoric remains politically active.
economy: The set links the Fed, French growth revisions, tariffs, and energy to show the transmission from geopolitics into real activity.
Short-term market chatter was dropped unless it pointed to a policy shift or forecast revision.
technology: The tech set favors TPU updates, Linux security, and Anthropic-linked AI governance because they touch infrastructure, safety, and regulation.
Research-style items were kept only when they could be connected to product or deployment decisions.
decisions: Older AI launches and thinly sourced rumor items were removed because they did not support current decision-making.
Speculative company rumors were not used.
